convention: Research FOLDERS are numbered in CHRONOLOGICAL BUILD ORDER (E1, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7, E8 in the order they were built; 'E2' was never used as a folder label because the first folder built took 'E1'). This chronological-folder convention COINCIDES with BLUEPRINT-canonical numbering for E3/E4/E5/E7/E8, and DIFFERS for the first two scientific topics (see 'documented_slip'). Folders are deliberately NOT renamed: renaming would touch the no-omission manifest, the seed.json foundation paths, the SSOT loader, and the cross-links already deposited in sibling/site releases. The reconciliation is therefore THIS MAP, enforced by the verifier so the labels cannot silently drift.
